originalTitle: Coinbase shares fall after crypto exchange posts disappointing second-quarter results
summary: Coinbase's Thursday report marked its third straight quarter missing Wall Street's forecasts for revenue and earnings.
content:
Coinbase shares dropped in extended trading on Thursday after the crypto platform posted a wider-than-expected loss for the second quarter, underscoring the continued troubles resulting from a deepening crypto winter despite its efforts to diversify revenue.

Here's how Coinbase performed in its quarter ended June 30, compared with what Wall Street was expecting, based on a survey of analysts by LSEG:

Coinbase's Thursday report marked its third straight quarter missing Wall Street's forecasts for revenue and earnings. The ​company reported a loss of $359.5 ⁠million, or $1.36 ‌per share, for ‌the quarter ended June ⁠30, compared with a ⁠profit ⁠of $1.43 billion, or $5.14 per ​share, ‌a year earlier.

Coinbase net income is often distorted by accounting rules that require it to value its large crypto holdings based on whatever the price is at the end of the quarter, causing reported earnings to swing widely even when no assets are sold.

Revenue fell to $1.2 billion from $1.5 billion a year ago.

Shares dropped more than 7% after the bell on Thursday.

The results come against a second-quarter market backdrop in which the price of bitcoin was largely range-bound. Although conditions improved over the weakness from the previous quarter, flows into bitcoin ETFs shifted to a sustained period of outflows. A challenging macro environment marked by elevated interest rates and broader market volatility also weighed on investors appetite for risk.

But revenue from subscriptions made up a larger piece of the overall business in the quarter, offering a bright spot for those searching for signs that the company's diversification efforts are taking hold.

Subscriptions brought in $555 million, while transaction revenue came in at $599 million. To be sure, both categories missed Wall Street's expectations and came in lower than a year prior, reflecting the continued troubles caused by the broader weakness in the crypto sector.

Coinbase has attempted to convince investors that it can broaden the business beyond its core crypto trading operations. Key to that push is the rollout of products under the subscription umbrella which can bring in revenue that's insulated from swings in trading volumes.

Within the core business, CEO Brian Armstrong touted that Coinbase reached another all-time high for market share in crypto trading. He said that can serve as evidence that Coinbase can perform in any market condition.

"Coinbase is no longer a bet just on the price of bitcoin," Armstrong said in the company's earnings release. "All of financial services are getting updated by crypto, whether that's trading or payments or lending, and Coinbase is the best-positioned company in the world to power this."

Coinbase's stablecoin revenue unexpectedly fell to $292 million, a drop of $17 million from the second quarter of 2025. Analysts surveyed by StreetAccount were forecasting this arm's revenue would come in at $327.2 million.
chineseTitle: 加密货币交易所发布令人失望的第二季度业绩后 Coinbase 股价下跌
chineseSummary: Coinbase 周四的报告标志着其连续第三个季度的收入和盈利未达到华尔街的预期。
chineseContent:
周四，Coinbase 股价在盘后交易中下跌，此前该加密货币平台公布第二季度亏损超出预期，突显尽管该公司努力实现收入多元化，但加密货币寒冬加深仍带来持续的麻烦。

根据 LSEG 对分析师的调查，Coinbase 在截至 6 月 30 日的季度中的表现与华尔街的预期相比如下：

Coinbase 周四的报告标志着其连续第三个季度的收入和盈利未达到华尔街的预期。该公司报告称，截至 6 月 30 日的季度亏损 3.595 亿美元，即每股 1.36 美元，而一年前的利润为 14.3 亿美元，即每股 5.14 美元。

Coinbase 的净利润经常受到会计规则的扭曲，会计规则要求其根据季度末的价格对其持有的大量加密货币进行估值，导致即使没有出售资产，报告的收益也会大幅波动。

收入从一年前的 15 亿美元降至 12 亿美元。

周四盘后股价下跌超过 7%。

这一结果是在第二季度的市场背景下得出的，其中比特币的价格基本上是区间波动的。尽管情况较上一季度的疲软有所改善，但流入比特币 ETF 的资金转向持续流出。以利率上升和市场波动为特征的充满挑战的宏观环境也打压了投资者的风险偏好。

但订阅收入在本季度整体业务中所占比例较大，为那些寻找该公司多元化努力正在扎根的迹象的人提供了一个亮点。

订阅收入为 5.55 亿美元，交易收入为 5.99 亿美元。可以肯定的是，这两个类别都没有达到华尔街的预期，并且低于一年前的水平，反映出加密货币行业整体疲软带来的持续问题。

Coinbase 试图让投资者相信，它可以将业务扩展到核心加密货币交易业务之外。这一推动的关键是在订阅保护伞下推出产品，这可以带来不受交易量波动影响的收入。

在核心业务领域，首席执行官布莱恩·阿姆斯特朗 (Brian Armstrong) 表示，Coinbase 在加密货币交易市场份额方面再创历史新高。他表示，这可以作为 Coinbase 在任何市场条件下都能表现的证据。

阿姆斯特朗在公司财报中表示：“Coinbase 不再只是押注比特币价格。” “所有的金融服务都在通过加密技术进行更新，无论是交易、支付还是借贷，而 Coinbase 是世界上最有能力推动这一点的公司。”

Coinbase 的稳定币收入意外下降至 2.92 亿美元，比 2025 年第二季度减少 1700 万美元。StreetAccount 调查的分析师预测该部门的收入将为 3.272 亿美元。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
